```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 1. UTILITY FUNCTIONS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  ifelse( is.na( denominator ) | denominator == 0, NA_real_, numerator / denominator )
}
check_required_columns <- function( data, required_columns, data_name
) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names( data ) )
  if ( length( missing_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( data_name, " is missing required columns: ", paste( missing_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
}
check_finite_numeric_columns <- function( data, columns, data_name
) {
  invalid_columns <- columns[ purrr::map_lgl( columns, ~ any( !is.finite( data[[.x]] ) ) ) ]
  if ( length( invalid_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( data_name, " contains non-finite values in: ", paste( invalid_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
}
clamp <- function( x, lower, upper
) {
  pmin( pmax( x, lower ), upper )
}
scenario_seed <- function( scenario_id
) {
  scenario_offsets <- c( baseline = 1L, high_competition = 2L, low_competition = 3L, fragmented_market = 4L )
  if ( !scenario_id %in% names( scenario_offsets )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "No random-number seed registered for scenario: ", scenario_id ) )
  }
  config$competitor_seed_base + unname( scenario_offsets[ scenario_id ] )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 2. READ AND VALIDATE MODULE 2 PRICING PROFILES
# Module 2 validation is mandatory.
if (!file.exists(config$module2_validation_file)) {
  stop( "Missing Module 2 validation file: ", config$module2_validation_file, ". Run the revised Module 2 first." )
}
module2_validation_checks <- readr::read_csv( config$module2_validation_file, show_col_types = FALSE )
check_required_columns( module2_validation_checks, c("check_name", "pass"),
  "technical_pricing_validation_checks.csv" )
failed_module2_checks <- if ("required_for_progress" %in% names(module2_validation_checks)) {
  module2_validation_checks %>% filter(required_for_progress, !pass)
} else {
  module2_validation_checks %>% filter(!pass)
}
if (nrow(failed_module2_checks) > 0L) {
  stop( "Module 2 contains failed validation checks: ", paste(failed_module2_checks$check_name, collapse = "; ") )
}
# Where the revised Module 2 handoff checks are present, require them explicitly.
module2_handoff_check_names <- c( "Canonical Module 3 pricing-profile rows",
  "Canonical Module 3 profile contains 2025 only", "Canonical Module 3 profile contains TEST split only",
  "Current-year outcomes absent from Module 3 profile", "Truth/latent variables absent from Module 3 profile" )
available_handoff_checks <- module2_validation_checks %>% filter(check_name %in% module2_handoff_check_names)
if ( nrow(available_handoff_checks) > 0L && any(!available_handoff_checks$pass)
) {
  stop( "Module 2 downstream handoff checks failed: ", paste(
      available_handoff_checks$check_name[!available_handoff_checks$pass], collapse = "; " ) )
}
if (!file.exists(config$input_file)) {
  stop( paste0( "Missing Module 2 pricing-profile file: ", config$input_file, ". Run the revised Module 2 first." )
  )
}
pricing_profiles <- readr::read_csv( config$input_file, show_col_types = FALSE )
required_columns <- c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "policy_year", "data_split", "state", "remoteness_area",
  "driver_age", "licence_years", "vehicle_age", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power", "engine_capacity_l",
  "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission", "vehicle_value", "annual_km",
  "voluntary_excess", "exposure", "prior_claims_5yr", "claim_free_years", "estimated_claim_frequency",
  "estimated_claim_severity", "estimated_expected_claim_cost", "technical_loading", "technical_premium" )
check_required_columns( pricing_profiles, required_columns, "technical_pricing_profiles.csv" )
if (nrow(pricing_profiles) != config$expected_profiles) {
  stop( "Module 3 requires exactly ", config$expected_profiles, " 2025 quote profiles from Module 2; observed ",
    nrow(pricing_profiles), "." )
}
if (anyDuplicated(pricing_profiles$policy_id) > 0L) {
  stop("policy_id is not unique in technical_pricing_profiles.csv.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(pricing_profiles$quote_profile_id) > 0L) {
  stop("quote_profile_id is not unique in technical_pricing_profiles.csv.")
}
pricing_profiles <- pricing_profiles %>% mutate( policy_year = as.integer(policy_year),
    data_split = tolower(trimws(as.character(data_split))) )
if (!all(pricing_profiles$policy_year == config$expected_policy_year)) {
  stop( "Module 3 must receive the 2025 out-of-time technical-pricing cohort only." )
}
if (!all(pricing_profiles$data_split == "test")) {
  stop( paste( "The Module 2 handoff must contain technical-pricing TEST rows only.", "Observed labels:",
      paste(sort(unique(pricing_profiles$data_split)), collapse = ", ") ) )
}
numeric_pricing_fields <- c( "estimated_claim_frequency", "estimated_claim_severity",
  "estimated_expected_claim_cost", "technical_loading", "technical_premium" )
check_finite_numeric_columns( pricing_profiles, numeric_pricing_fields, "technical_pricing_profiles.csv" )
if ( any(pricing_profiles$estimated_claim_frequency <= 0) || any(pricing_profiles$estimated_claim_severity <= 0) ||
    any(pricing_profiles$estimated_expected_claim_cost <= 0) || any(pricing_profiles$technical_premium <= 0)
) {
  stop( paste( "Estimated frequency, severity, expected claims cost and technical premium",
      "must all be strictly positive." ) )
}
vehicle_spec_numeric_fields <- c( "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm",
  "unladen_weight_kg" )
check_finite_numeric_columns( pricing_profiles, vehicle_spec_numeric_fields, "technical_pricing_profiles.csv" )
if ( any(pricing_profiles$engine_capacity_l < 0) || any(pricing_profiles$cylinder_count < 0) ||
    any(pricing_profiles$power_kw <= 0) || any(pricing_profiles$torque_nm <= 0) ||
    any(pricing_profiles$unladen_weight_kg <= 0)
) {
  stop( paste( "Invalid CarExpert vehicle specification values detected.",
      "Engine capacity/cylinders may be zero only where not applicable;",
      "power, torque and unladen weight must be strictly positive." ) )
}
if ( anyNA(pricing_profiles$transmission) || any(trimws(as.character(pricing_profiles$transmission)) == "")
) {
  stop("transmission contains missing or blank values.")
}
# Preserve the technical-pricing provenance before assigning a new split for the
# conversion-modelling stage.
pricing_profiles <- pricing_profiles %>% rename( technical_data_split = data_split )
conversion_split_shares <- c( train = config$conversion_train_share,
  validation = config$conversion_validation_share, test = config$conversion_test_share )
if ( any(!is.finite(conversion_split_shares)) || any(conversion_split_shares <= 0) ||
    abs(sum(conversion_split_shares) - 1) > 1e-12
) {
  stop("Conversion split shares must be positive and sum exactly to 1.")
}
conversion_split_counts <- c( train = as.integer(round(config$expected_profiles * config$conversion_train_share)),
  validation = as.integer(round(config$expected_profiles * config$conversion_validation_share)) )
conversion_split_counts <- c( conversion_split_counts,
  test = config$expected_profiles - sum(conversion_split_counts) )
if (any(conversion_split_counts <= 0L)) {
  stop("Conversion split configuration produced an empty partition.")
}
set.seed(config$conversion_split_seed)
split_order <- sample(seq_len(nrow(pricing_profiles)))
split_labels <- c( rep("train", conversion_split_counts[["train"]]),
  rep("validation", conversion_split_counts[["validation"]]), rep("test", conversion_split_counts[["test"]]) )
conversion_data_split <- character(nrow(pricing_profiles))
conversion_data_split[split_order] <- split_labels
pricing_profiles <- pricing_profiles %>% mutate( conversion_data_split = factor( conversion_data_split,
      levels = c("train", "validation", "test") ),
    # Stable downstream alias. Modules 4-6 can continue using data_split while
    # technical_data_split preserves the separate Module 2 provenance.
    data_split = conversion_data_split )
conversion_split_summary <- pricing_profiles %>% count( conversion_data_split, name = "profiles" ) %>% mutate(
    share = profiles / sum(profiles) )
observed_conversion_split_counts <- setNames( conversion_split_summary$profiles,
  as.character(conversion_split_summary$conversion_data_split) )
if ( !identical( as.integer(observed_conversion_split_counts[c("train", "validation", "test")]),
    as.integer(conversion_split_counts[c("train", "validation", "test")]) )
) {
  stop("Conversion split did not reproduce the configured exact row counts.")
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 3. LEAKAGE CHECK
# Historical predictors such as prior_claims_5yr and claim_free_years are allowed.
# Current-period outcomes, latent truth and Module 1 audit-only variables are not.
explicit_forbidden_columns <- c( "claim_count", "pricing_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost",
  "reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost", "gross_claim_cost", "average_paid_claim_cost",
  "pricing_average_paid_claim_cost", "largest_paid_claim", "total_loss_claim_count", "any_total_loss",
  "reconstructed_reported_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost_nominal", "gross_claim_cost_nominal",
  "average_paid_claim_cost_nominal", "largest_paid_claim_nominal", "driver_sex_audit" )
pattern_forbidden_columns <- names(pricing_profiles)[ str_detect( names(pricing_profiles), regex( paste( c(
          "^true_", "frailty", "^latent_" ), collapse = "|" ), ignore_case = TRUE ) ) ]
forbidden_columns <- union( intersect(explicit_forbidden_columns, names(pricing_profiles)),
  pattern_forbidden_columns )
if (length(forbidden_columns) > 0L) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 3 leakage check failed. Forbidden columns detected: ",
      paste(forbidden_columns, collapse = ", ") ) )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. MARKET-SCENARIO REGISTER
# Scenario parameters below are stress assumptions, not estimates of actual
# Australian insurer behaviour.
# stance_shift:
#   parallel shift in competitor log-price stance.
# stance_scale:
#   widens/narrows differences between the six competitor archetypes.
# availability_shift:
#   shifts the probability that a competitor returns a quote.
# noise_sd:
#   residual within-profile quote dispersion.
# appetite_scale:
#   scales segment-specific competitive appetite.
market_scenario_register <- tribble( ~scenario_id, ~scenario_label, ~scenario_description, ~stance_shift,
  ~stance_scale, ~availability_shift, ~noise_sd, ~appetite_scale, "baseline", "Baseline market", paste(
    "Six stylised competitors with heterogeneous price stance,",
    "quote availability, segment appetite and moderate quote dispersion." ), 0.000, 1.00, 0.00, 0.045, 1.00,
  "high_competition", "High competition", paste(
    "Competitors are more price-aggressive and more likely to return quotes,",
    "increasing the intensity of the comparison set." ), -0.025, 1.00, 0.04, 0.050, 1.10, "low_competition",
  "Low competition", paste( "Competitors are less price-aggressive and less likely to return quotes,",
    "creating a thinner comparison set." ), 0.025, 0.90, -0.16, 0.035, 0.85, "fragmented_market",
  "Fragmented market", paste( "Competitor pricing stances and segment appetites are more dispersed",
    "and residual quote variation is materially larger." ), 0.000, 1.55, -0.02, 0.080, 1.50 )
```


```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 5. SIX BASELINE COMPETITOR ARCHETYPES
# These are stylised competitors, not named firms.
# log_stance is measured relative to the Module 2 technical premium:
# exp(-0.055) ~= 0.946
# exp( 0.065) ~= 1.067
competitor_assumptions <- tribble( ~competitor_id, ~competitor_archetype, ~log_stance, ~quote_return_probability,
  "C01", "Value Direct", -0.055, 0.96, "C02", "Mainstream Alpha", -0.015, 0.98, "C03", "Mainstream Beta", 0.010,
  0.96, "C04", "Premium Brand", 0.065, 0.90, "C05", "Young Driver Specialist", 0.025, 0.92, "C06",
  "Low-Risk Specialist", 0.015, 0.91 )
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. GENERATE THE FOCAL COMMERCIAL QUOTE
# The focal commercial multiplier is deliberately independent of observable
# policy risk characteristics.
set.seed(
  config$focal_seed )
focal_multiplier <- runif( n = nrow( pricing_profiles ), min = config$focal_multiplier_lower, max =
    config$focal_multiplier_upper )
focal_profiles <- pricing_profiles %>% mutate( focal_price_multiplier = focal_multiplier, focal_quote =
      technical_premium * focal_price_multiplier,
    # Stable aliases retained for downstream compatibility.
    focal_benchmark_quote = focal_quote, focal_price = focal_quote, focal_technical_premium = technical_premium,
    fitted_annual_loss_cost = estimated_expected_claim_cost, commercial_log_adjustment = log( focal_quote /
          technical_premium ) )
if ( any( focal_profiles$focal_price_multiplier < config$focal_multiplier_lower ) | any(
      focal_profiles$focal_price_multiplier > config$focal_multiplier_upper )
) {
  stop( "Generated focal price multiplier fell outside configured support." )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. FOCAL-PRICE IDENTIFICATION DIAGNOSTIC
# The focal quote itself should be risk-correlated because it contains the
# technical premium. The correct diagnostic is therefore whether risk variables
# explain the residual commercial adjustment around technical premium.
risk_diagnostic_data <- focal_profiles %>% mutate( state = factor( state ), remoteness_area = factor(
        remoteness_area ), vehicle_segment = factor( vehicle_segment ), motive_power = factor( motive_power ),
    transmission = factor( transmission ) )
focal_adjustment_risk_model <- lm( commercial_log_adjustment ~ driver_age + licence_years + vehicle_age + log(
      pmax( vehicle_value, 1 ) ) + log( pmax( annual_km, 1 ) ) + prior_claims_5yr + claim_free_years +
    voluntary_excess + state + remoteness_area + vehicle_segment + motive_power + engine_capacity_l +
    cylinder_count + log( pmax( power_kw, 1 ) ) + log( pmax( torque_nm, 1 ) ) + log( pmax( unladen_weight_kg, 1 )
    ) + transmission, data = risk_diagnostic_data )
risk_model_r_squared <- summary( focal_adjustment_risk_model )$r.squared
risk_model_adjusted_r_squared <- summary( focal_adjustment_risk_model )$adj.r.squared
```


```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. COMPETITOR SEGMENT-APPETITE FUNCTION
calculate_segment_adjustment <- function( competitor_archetype, vehicle_segment, vehicle_value, driver_age,
    prior_claims_5yr, claim_free_years, appetite_scale
) {
  raw_adjustment <- case_when( competitor_archetype == "Mainstream Beta" & vehicle_segment == "Small Passenger" ~
      -0.020, competitor_archetype == "Mainstream Beta" & vehicle_segment == "Sports/Performance" ~ 0.020,
    competitor_archetype == "Premium Brand" & vehicle_value >= 45000 & driver_age >= 35 & driver_age <= 69 ~
      -0.020, competitor_archetype == "Premium Brand" & driver_age <= 24 ~ 0.025, competitor_archetype ==
      "Young Driver Specialist" & driver_age <= 29 ~ -0.055, competitor_archetype == "Young Driver Specialist" &
      driver_age >= 55 ~ 0.018, competitor_archetype == "Low-Risk Specialist" & prior_claims_5yr == 0 &
      claim_free_years >= 3 ~ -0.045, competitor_archetype == "Low-Risk Specialist" & prior_claims_5yr >= 2 ~
      0.030, TRUE ~ 0 )
  raw_adjustment * appetite_scale
}
```


```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 10. GENERATE ONE MARKET SCENARIO
generate_market_scenario <- function( requested_scenario_id
) {
  scenario_row <- market_scenario_register %>% filter( .data$scenario_id == .env$requested_scenario_id )
  if ( nrow( scenario_row ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Scenario register lookup failed for: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  # The CarExpert vehicle specifications remain in focal_profiles and therefore
  # flow into quote_market. They are intentionally not duplicated across the
  # long competitor table because the competitor pricing DGP does not use them.
  profile_base <- focal_profiles %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, technical_premium, focal_quote,
      driver_age, vehicle_segment, vehicle_value, prior_claims_5yr, claim_free_years )
  competitor_quotes_all <- tidyr::crossing( profile_base, competitor_assumptions ) %>% mutate( scenario_id =
        requested_scenario_id, market_scenario_id = requested_scenario_id, scenario_log_stance = ( log_stance *
            scenario_row$stance_scale[ 1 ] ) + scenario_row$stance_shift[ 1 ], scenario_quote_return_probability =
        clamp( quote_return_probability + scenario_row$availability_shift[ 1 ], 0.50, 0.995 ),
      segment_log_adjustment = calculate_segment_adjustment( competitor_archetype = competitor_archetype,
          vehicle_segment = vehicle_segment, vehicle_value = vehicle_value, driver_age = driver_age,
          prior_claims_5yr = prior_claims_5yr, claim_free_years = claim_free_years, appetite_scale =
            scenario_row$appetite_scale[ 1 ] ) )
  set.seed(
    scenario_seed( requested_scenario_id ) )
  competitor_quotes_all <- competitor_quotes_all %>% mutate( availability_draw = runif( n() ), quote_returned_raw =
        availability_draw <= scenario_quote_return_probability, stochastic_log_noise = rnorm( n(), mean = 0, sd =
            scenario_row$noise_sd[ 1 ] ), raw_competitor_multiplier = exp( scenario_log_stance +
            segment_log_adjustment + stochastic_log_noise ), competitor_multiplier = clamp(
          raw_competitor_multiplier, config$competitor_multiplier_lower, config$competitor_multiplier_upper ),
      competitor_quote = technical_premium * competitor_multiplier ) %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id
    ) %>% mutate(
      # A comparison profile must contain at least two competitor quotes.
      # If the availability process returns fewer than two, the competitors
      # with the two smallest availability draws are retained.
      quote_returned = if ( sum( quote_returned_raw ) >= config$minimum_returned_competitors
        ) {
          quote_returned_raw
        } else {
          rank( availability_draw, ties.method = "first" ) <= config$minimum_returned_competitors
        } ) %>% ungroup()
  if ( any( !is.finite( competitor_quotes_all$competitor_quote ) ) | any(
        competitor_quotes_all$competitor_quote <= 0 )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Invalid competitor quote generated for scenario: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  competitor_quotes_available <- competitor_quotes_all %>% filter( quote_returned )
  returned_count_check <- competitor_quotes_available %>% count( policy_id, quote_profile_id, name = "n_returned" )
  if ( nrow( returned_count_check ) != nrow( focal_profiles ) | any( returned_count_check$n_returned <
          config$minimum_returned_competitors )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Competitor availability validation failed for scenario: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  market_summary <- competitor_quotes_available %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>% summarise(
      n_competitor_quotes = n(), competitor_count = n(), cheapest_competitor_quote = min( competitor_quote ),
      median_competitor_quote = median( competitor_quote ), mean_competitor_quote = mean( competitor_quote ),
      sd_competitor_quote = sd( competitor_quote ), maximum_competitor_quote = max( competitor_quote ),
      minimum_competitor_quote = min( competitor_quote ), within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio = safe_divide(
          maximum_competitor_quote, minimum_competitor_quote ), focal_rank = 1L + sum( competitor_quote < first(
                focal_quote ) ), market_median_quote = median( c( competitor_quote, first( focal_quote ) ) ),
      lowest_market_quote = min( c( competitor_quote, first( focal_quote ) ) ), highest_market_quote = max( c(
            competitor_quote, first( focal_quote ) ) ), .groups = "drop" )
  quote_market <- focal_profiles %>% left_join( market_summary, by = c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>%
    mutate( scenario_id = requested_scenario_id, market_scenario_id = requested_scenario_id, relative_price =
        safe_divide( focal_quote, cheapest_competitor_quote ), relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor =
        relative_price, price_gap_to_cheapest = focal_quote - cheapest_competitor_quote, gap_to_cheapest =
        price_gap_to_cheapest, percentage_gap_to_cheapest_competitor = relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor - 1,
      relative_price_to_market_median = safe_divide( focal_quote, market_median_quote ),
      relative_to_market_median = relative_price_to_market_median, distance_to_market_median = focal_quote -
          market_median_quote, competitor_quote_cv = safe_divide( sd_competitor_quote, mean_competitor_quote ),
      market_spread_ratio = safe_divide( highest_market_quote, lowest_market_quote ), focal_is_cheapest =
        focal_quote <= cheapest_competitor_quote, focal_within_5pct_of_cheapest = focal_quote <= 1.05 *
            cheapest_competitor_quote, focal_rank_percentile = safe_divide( focal_rank - 1, n_competitor_quotes ) )
  if ( nrow( quote_market ) != nrow( focal_profiles )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Quote-market row count changed for scenario: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  if ( anyDuplicated( quote_market$quote_profile_id ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "quote_profile_id is duplicated for scenario: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  finite_market_fields <- c( "focal_quote", "cheapest_competitor_quote", "median_competitor_quote",
    "market_median_quote", "relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor", "relative_price_to_market_median",
    "within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio" )
  if ( any( !is.finite( as.matrix( quote_market[ finite_market_fields ] ) ) )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Non-finite market-position variables detected for scenario: ", requested_scenario_id ) )
  }
  list( quote_market = quote_market, competitor_quotes_all = competitor_quotes_all, competitor_quotes_available =
      competitor_quotes_available )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 12. MARKET SUMMARIES
quote_market_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr( scenario_results, function( scenario_result, scenario_name
    ) {
      q <- scenario_result$quote_market
      tibble( scenario_id = scenario_name, profiles = nrow( q ), mean_returned_competitors = mean(
            q$n_competitor_quotes ), minimum_returned_competitors = min( q$n_competitor_quotes ),
        maximum_returned_competitors = max( q$n_competitor_quotes ), mean_technical_premium = mean(
            q$technical_premium ), mean_focal_quote = mean( q$focal_quote ), mean_focal_multiplier = mean(
            q$focal_price_multiplier ), mean_competitor_quote = mean( q$mean_competitor_quote ),
        median_relative_price_to_cheapest = median( q$relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ),
        mean_relative_price_to_cheapest = mean( q$relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ),
        mean_percentage_gap_to_cheapest = mean( q$percentage_gap_to_cheapest_competitor ), median_focal_rank =
          median( q$focal_rank ), mean_focal_rank = mean( q$focal_rank ), focal_cheapest_share = mean(
            q$focal_is_cheapest ), focal_within_5pct_cheapest_share = mean( q$focal_within_5pct_of_cheapest ),
        mean_competitor_quote_cv = mean( q$competitor_quote_cv ), median_competitor_spread_ratio = median(
            q$within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio ) )
    } )
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 15. VALIDATION CHECKS
global_validation_checks <- tribble( ~scenario_id, ~check_name, ~observed_value, ~lower_bound, ~upper_bound,
  "GLOBAL", "Input pricing-profile rows", nrow(pricing_profiles), config$expected_profiles,
  config$expected_profiles, "GLOBAL", "Input policy year is 2025 only",
  as.numeric(all(pricing_profiles$policy_year == config$expected_policy_year)), 1, 1, "GLOBAL",
  "Technical-pricing provenance is TEST only", as.numeric(all(pricing_profiles$technical_data_split == "test")), 1,
  1, "GLOBAL", "Conversion TRAIN rows", sum(as.character(pricing_profiles$conversion_data_split) == "train"),
  conversion_split_counts[["train"]], conversion_split_counts[["train"]], "GLOBAL", "Conversion VALIDATION rows",
  sum(as.character(pricing_profiles$conversion_data_split) == "validation"),
  conversion_split_counts[["validation"]], conversion_split_counts[["validation"]], "GLOBAL",
  "Conversion TEST rows", sum(as.character(pricing_profiles$conversion_data_split) == "test"),
  conversion_split_counts[["test"]], conversion_split_counts[["test"]], "GLOBAL",
  "Downstream data_split matches conversion_data_split", as.numeric( all(
      as.character(pricing_profiles$data_split) == as.character(pricing_profiles$conversion_data_split) ) ), 1, 1,
  "GLOBAL", "Unique input quote-profile IDs", n_distinct(pricing_profiles$quote_profile_id),
  nrow(pricing_profiles), nrow(pricing_profiles), "GLOBAL", "No current-year or latent leakage fields",
  length(forbidden_columns), 0, 0, "GLOBAL", "Finite positive expected claims cost", mean(
    is.finite(pricing_profiles$estimated_expected_claim_cost) & pricing_profiles$estimated_expected_claim_cost > 0
  ), 1, 1, "GLOBAL", "Finite positive technical premium", mean( is.finite(pricing_profiles$technical_premium) &
      pricing_profiles$technical_premium > 0 ), 1, 1, "GLOBAL", "CarExpert vehicle-specification fields present",
  as.numeric( all( c( "motive_power", "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm",
        "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission" ) %in% names(focal_profiles) ) ), 1, 1, "GLOBAL",
  "Finite positive power share", mean(is.finite(focal_profiles$power_kw) & focal_profiles$power_kw > 0), 1, 1,
  "GLOBAL", "Finite positive torque share",
  mean(is.finite(focal_profiles$torque_nm) & focal_profiles$torque_nm > 0), 1, 1, "GLOBAL",
  "Finite positive unladen-weight share", mean( is.finite(focal_profiles$unladen_weight_kg) &
      focal_profiles$unladen_weight_kg > 0 ), 1, 1, "GLOBAL", "Nonblank transmission share", mean(
    !is.na(focal_profiles$transmission) & trimws(as.character(focal_profiles$transmission)) != "" ), 1, 1,
  "GLOBAL", "Mean focal price multiplier", mean(focal_profiles$focal_price_multiplier), 0.99, 1.01, "GLOBAL",
  "Minimum focal multiplier inside support", min(focal_profiles$focal_price_multiplier),
  config$focal_multiplier_lower, config$focal_multiplier_upper, "GLOBAL",
  "Maximum focal multiplier inside support", max(focal_profiles$focal_price_multiplier),
  config$focal_multiplier_lower, config$focal_multiplier_upper, "GLOBAL",
  "Focal commercial-adjustment risk R-squared", risk_model_r_squared, 0, config$maximum_focal_adjustment_r_squared
) %>% mutate( pass = observed_value >= lower_bound & observed_value <= upper_bound )
scenario_validation_checks <- purrr::imap_dfr( scenario_results, function( scenario_result, scenario_name
    ) {
      q <- scenario_result$quote_market
      c_all <- scenario_result$competitor_quotes_all
      c_available <- scenario_result$competitor_quotes_available
      tribble( ~scenario_id, ~check_name, ~observed_value, ~lower_bound, ~upper_bound, scenario_name,
        "Quote-market rows", nrow( q ), nrow( focal_profiles ), nrow( focal_profiles ), scenario_name,
        "Unique quote-profile IDs", n_distinct( q$quote_profile_id ), nrow( focal_profiles ), nrow( focal_profiles
        ), scenario_name, "Potential competitor rows", nrow( c_all ), nrow( focal_profiles ) * nrow(
            competitor_assumptions ), nrow( focal_profiles ) * nrow( competitor_assumptions ), scenario_name,
        "Minimum returned competitors", min( q$n_competitor_quotes ), config$minimum_returned_competitors, nrow(
          competitor_assumptions ), scenario_name, "Maximum returned competitors", max( q$n_competitor_quotes ),
        config$minimum_returned_competitors, nrow( competitor_assumptions ), scenario_name,
        "CarExpert fields retained in quote market", as.numeric( all( c( "motive_power", "engine_capacity_l",
              "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission" ) %in% names( q ) ) ),
        1, 1, scenario_name, "Finite positive focal quotes", mean( is.finite( q$focal_quote ) & q$focal_quote > 0
        ), 1, 1, scenario_name, "Finite positive returned competitor quotes", mean( is.finite(
            c_available$competitor_quote ) & c_available$competitor_quote > 0 ), 1, 1, scenario_name,
        "Valid focal ranks", mean( q$focal_rank >= 1 & q$focal_rank <= q$n_competitor_quotes + 1 ), 1, 1,
        scenario_name, "Finite market-position variables", mean( is.finite( q$relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor
          ) & is.finite( q$relative_price_to_market_median ) & is.finite( q$within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio
            ) ), 1, 1 )
    } ) %>% mutate( pass = observed_value >= lower_bound & observed_value <= upper_bound )
quote_market_validation_checks <- bind_rows( global_validation_checks, scenario_validation_checks )
if (any(!quote_market_validation_checks$pass)) {
  failed_checks <- quote_market_validation_checks %>% filter(!pass)
  stop( "Module 3 validation failed: ", paste(failed_checks$check_name, collapse = "; "),
    ". Review quote_market_validation_checks.csv before Module 4." )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 16. WRITE SCENARIO-SPECIFIC OUTPUTS (MULTI-SCENARIO RUNS ONLY)
# The frozen baseline and each Module 7 sensitivity case run one scenario at a
# time, so scenario-suffixed files would duplicate the canonical files below.
# Retain them only for an intentional direct multi-scenario diagnostic run.
if (length(scenario_results) > 1L) {
  purrr::iwalk(scenario_results, function(scenario_result, scenario_name) {
    readr::write_csv( scenario_result$quote_market,
      file.path(config$output_dir, paste0("quote_market_", scenario_name, ".csv")) )
    readr::write_csv( scenario_result$competitor_quotes_all,
      file.path(config$output_dir, paste0("competitor_quotes_all_", scenario_name, ".csv")) )
    readr::write_csv( scenario_result$competitor_quotes_available,
      file.path(config$output_dir, paste0("competitor_quotes_available_", scenario_name, ".csv")) )
  })
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 17. WRITE CANONICAL OUTPUTS
# When exactly one market scenario is run, stable filenames are created for the
# next module. This is also what Module 7 expects inside each isolated case.

) {
  canonical_result <- scenario_results[[1]]
  readr::write_csv( canonical_result$quote_market, file.path( config$output_dir, "quote_market.csv" ) )
  readr::write_csv( canonical_result$competitor_quotes_available, file.path( config$output_dir,
      "competitor_quotes.csv" ) )
  readr::write_csv( canonical_result$competitor_quotes_available, file.path( config$output_dir,

  readr::write_csv( canonical_result$competitor_quotes_all, file.path( config$output_dir,
      "competitor_quotes_all.csv" ) )
  saveRDS( canonical_result$quote_market, file.path( config$output_dir, "quote_market.rds" ) )
  saveRDS( canonical_result$competitor_quotes_available, file.path( config$output_dir,
      "competitor_quotes_available.rds" ) )
}
```

```{r module-3-quote-market, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
if ( isTRUE( config$write_plots )

      bins = 60 ) + labs( x = "Focal quote / cheapest competitor quote", y = "Quote profiles",
```
